## #1 ✅ 1901 Census: Stephen Gleeson — Complete Household

**Record:** House 3, Boherygeela East, DED Crean, Co. Limerick, 1901  
**Source:** nationalarchives.ie Census Search (record id 6911950)

| Name | Age | Relation | Occupation | Marital Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Stephen Gleeson** | 62 | Head | Farmer | Married |
| **Mary Gleeson** | 58 | Wife | Farmer | Married |
| Stephen Jr | 34 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Hanoria | 32 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Kate | 30 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Jeremiah | 28 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Timothy | 26 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Anne | 20 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Bridget Rahelly | 19 | Servant | Gen. Servant | — |

**Key findings:**
- Wife's name is **Mary** (born ~1843), alive in 1901.
- Six children in household 1901: Stephen Jr, Hanoria/Nora, Kate, Jeremiah, Timothy, Anne.
- Jeremiah (age 28 in 1901, ~34 at Stephen's 1907 death) — consistent with being informant on death cert.
- Bohergeela is indexed as two townlands: East (Stephen) and West (Timothy), both in DED **Crean** — NOT Meanus. Future searches must use DED = Crean.

**Key findings:**

- Wife: **Mary Anne**. Children: Kathleen, Stephen J, Helena.
- In 1911: only Kathleen (45) and Helena (30) remain at Boherygeela, DED Crean.
- Stephen J (age 30 in Boherygeela West, 1901) = Timothy's son, not a separate household.

## #5 ✅ Death Cert FULL IMAGE: Our Patrick Gleeson — 7 December 1897

**Source:** irishgenealogy.ie Civil Records — full register image  
**File:** 4655639.pdf — Croom Register 1897, Entry #441  
**Group Registration ID:** 4224783  

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Entry No. | **441** |
| Date & Place of Death | **7th December 1897, Croom** |
| Name | **Patrick Gleeson** |
| Sex | Male |
| Condition | **Married** |
| Age | **60 years** |
| Occupation | **Carrier** |
| Cause of Death | Morbus cordis auricularis (heart disease), twelve months, certified |
| Informant | **Bridget Gleeson, Daughter, present at death, Croom** |
| Registered | 13th December 1897 |
| Registrar | Michl Shanahan, Assistant Registrar |

**Key findings:**
- **Condition: Married** ✅ — consistent with a surviving wife.
- **Occupation: Carrier** — carter/haulier, not "Farmer." Possible smallholder + trade, but a flag worth noting.
- **Informant: Bridget Gleeson, Daughter, present at death, Croom** — critical new data point. His daughter Bridget was resident in Croom town at time of death.
- **Age: 60** → born ~1837. If our Patrick was baptised Hospital ~1829, this gives an 8-year discrepancy. Either: (a) this is a different Patrick Gleeson; (b) age was significantly mis-stated by the informant; or (c) the Hospital 1829 baptism is misidentified.
- **Next step:** Search Croom Catholic parish baptism register (registers.nli.ie) for Bridget Gleeson, father Patrick, ~1855–1875. If mother = Margaret (Moloney), this is confirmed as our man.

## #6 ❌ 1901 Census: Margaret Gleeson Widow, Main Street Croom — **CORRECTION: THIS IS OUR FAMILY**

> **Correction note added 2026-06-07 (post-session-2):** Same uncorrected error as the v1 session notes. House 36 Main Street IS our family (Patrick's widow Margaret Moloney + daughters). The 14-yr-old Bridget reasoning is also wrong — a 14-yr-old daughter can certainly be a death-cert informant for a father who died at home. The 1924 marriage cert of Bridget × Michael O'Connor (Main St Croom, father Patrick Gleeson Farmer) confirms continuity. See `research/findings/patrick-gleeson/facts.md` (31 Mar 1901 row) and memory [[gleeson_patrick_1897_death_confirmed]] / [[gleeson_bridget_oconnor_1924_marriage]].

### Original (erroneous) findings preserved below for audit trail:


**Record:** House 36, Main Street, DED Croom, 1901 (record id 6913106)

| Name | Age | Relation | Occupation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Margaret Gleeson | 55 | Head | Shop Keeper (Widow) |
| Mary Gleeson | 24 | Daughter | Dress Maker |
| Bridget Gleeson | 18 | Daughter | House Keeper |
| John Fitzgerald | 36 | Boarder | Miller |

**Key findings:**
- Different Patrick Gleeson family — townsman/merchant, not a farmer/carrier.
- However: this Bridget Gleeson (age 18 in 1901, born ~1883) is too young to be the informant Bridget on the 1897 cert — she'd only be ~14. So the 1897 informant Bridget must be from a different household or by then married out.
- Our Patrick's widow has not yet been located in the 1901 census.

## Technical Notes for Future Sessions

- Old census URL (census.nationalarchives.ie) is decommissioned — use **nationalarchives.ie/collections/search-the-census/**
- DED for Boherygeela = **Crean** in NAI census system (not Meanus)
- irishgenealogy.ie requires: Civil Records selected + name/location/year + your name + Section 61 checkbox ticked
- Location autocomplete must be used on irishgenealogy.ie — type location and click the dropdown suggestion
- askaboutireland.ie Griffith's dropdowns are cascading JS — URL params do not work; use form interactively
- registers.nli.ie has free images but no transcripts — must browse by parish and date range
